component.name: LincleLINK
component.summary: Deduplicated game data storage and instance linking

description.p: LincleLINK stores game data in a content-addressed database folder where files are named by their MD5 hash, so identical files across game versions are kept only once. Instances record the original file names, paths and hashes, and can be linked back to any destination on the same partition as hard links, recreating the original directory structure without using additional disk space.
It can also check an instance against a .torrent file and link only the files that fully match its pieces, preparing a download location where a torrent client only fetches what is actually missing.
